context: Trains run on time, until they don't. When something changes you only get a fast announcement. Today: catching the key words and asking staff.

phrases.jp: まもなく、2{番線|ばんせん}に{電車|でんしゃ}が{参|まい}ります。
phrases.en: A train will soon arrive at platform 2.
phrases.note: {参|まい}ります is the humble form of {来|き}ます. You'll hear it all day.

phrases.jp: {黄色|きいろ}い{線|せん}の{内側|うちがわ}までお{下|さ}がりください。
phrases.en: Please stand behind the yellow line.

phrases.jp: 「{運転見合|うんてんみあ}わせ」って{何|なん}ですか。
phrases.note: {運転見合|うんてんみあ}わせ = service suspended. The most important word to recognise.

phrases.jp: {電車|でんしゃ}はいつ{動|うご}きますか。
phrases.en: When will the trains run again?

phrases.jp: え、{電車|でんしゃ}{止|と}まってるの？

dialogue_setting: On a platform, after an announcement you didn't fully catch.

dialogue.speaker: Announcement
dialogue.jp: {信号故障|しんごうこしょう}のため、{電車|でんしゃ}が{遅|おく}れております。
dialogue.en: Due to a signal failure, trains are running late.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.jp: すみません、{松本|まつもと}{行|ゆ}きの{電車|でんしゃ}は{来|き}ますか。
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is the train to Matsumoto coming?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.jp: {今|いま}、20{分|ぷん}ほど{遅|おく}れています。
dialogue.en: Right now it's about 20 minutes late.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.jp: そうですか。バスで{行|い}けますか。
dialogue.en: I see. Can I go by bus?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.jp: はい、{東口|ひがしぐち}からバスが{出|で}ていますよ。
dialogue.en: Yes, buses leave from the east exit.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.jp: わかりました。ありがとうございます。

kanji.where: On departure boards and on the side of trains. Going to a small station? This is the safe one.
kanji.related: Related: {快速|かいそく} rapid, {急行|きゅうこう} express.

tip.title: Delay certificates
tip.body: When trains run late, stations hand out {遅延証明書|ちえんしょうめいしょ} (delay certificates) so people can show their boss or school. If a train makes you late for volunteer work, grab one: it shows you take punctuality seriously.

challenge.prompt: Your train has stopped. Ask a station worker: "Excuse me, when will the train start running again?"
challenge.hint: when = いつ, run / move = {動|うご}きます
challenge.model_answer: すみません、{電車|でんしゃ}はいつ{動|うご}きますか。
